raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #46752. With `--speculative-algorithm DFLASH` or `DSPARK`, `repetition_penalty`, `frequency_penalty`, `presence_penalty` and `min_tokens` have no effect. Two causes:

1. `spec_prepare_for_decode` never cumulates penalty output tokens for the DFLASH family (only `eagle_prepare_for_decode` does), so penalizer state stays at identity.
2. DFLASH verify and its fast-path checks read `acc_linear_penalties`, which `SamplingBatchInfo` doesn't have, instead of the `acc_additive_penalties` / `acc_scaling_penalties` that `copy_for_forward()` produces. The dense fallback also scaled a zero buffer, which drops `repetition_penalty`.

## Modifications

- `spec_prepare_for_decode`: cumulate in the `is_dflash_family()` branch, as EAGLE does. It stays per branch so EAGLE doesn't count twice.
- `apply_dflash_verify_logits_adjustments`: apply `acc_additive_penalties` and `acc_scaling_penalties` broadcast over the verify block, as EAGLE verify does. The scheduler always hands workers a `copy_for_forward()` copy, so these buffers are the only way penalties arrive. The grammar fallback now applies only the vocab mask.
- `_can_skip_verify_logits` and `verify_logits_adjustments_are_noop` now see the accumulated buffers, so penalized batches take the eager verify path. This also covers the DSPARK block-accept estimator gate from the issue, which uses the same check.
- `test_dspark_sampling_accept_graph.py`: its fake `sampling_info` had the nonexistent `acc_linear_penalties` field; it now has the two real ones.

Penalties keep EAGLE's relaxed spec-decoding semantics (see Not covered). Requests without penalties are unaffected.

## Validation

Unit tests on Colab T4, from `a1966e1b5d` (main):

| Test | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| New `test/registered/unit/spec/test_dflash_verify_penalties.py` | 5 of 6 fail | 6 pass |
| `test_dspark_sampling_accept_graph.py::test_routes_only_all_sampled_static_steps` | pass | pass |
| Related suites (`test_schedule_batch_prepare_for_decode`, `test_decode_bookkeeping_ownership`, `test_mamba_prefill_track_metadata`) | 18 pass | 18 pass |

With `ninja` on PATH, the whole `test_dspark_sampling_accept_graph.py` file (CPU and CUDA cases) passes 7 of 7 on T4 with and without this PR. That run used upstream main as of today, which the PR applies to cleanly.

End to end on an L4, `/generate` at temperature 0, run on the first commit (the second commit only removes a branch the server never reaches). "Changed" means the output differs from the same request without the penalty.

| Server | repetition_penalty=2.0 | frequency_penalty=2.0 | presence_penalty=2.0 |
|---|---|---|---|
| DFLASH, main | unchanged | unchanged | unchanged |
| DFLASH, this PR | changed | changed | changed |
| DSPARK, main | unchanged | unchanged | unchanged |
| DSPARK, this PR | changed | unchanged* | unchanged* |

\* MiniCPM5-2B also ignores these on this prompt without speculative decoding. On an open-ended prompt, both change DSPARK output.

To reproduce, start the DFLASH server (docs flags at TP1, plus two flags to fit the L4):

```bash
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path Qwen/Qwen3-4B --speculative-algorithm DFLASH --speculative-draft-model-path z-lab/Qwen3-4B-DFlash-b16 --attention-backend flashinfer --speculative-draft-attention-backend flashinfer --cuda-graph-backend-prefill disabled --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 4 --mem-fraction-static 0.8
```

Then send the request with and without the penalty and compare the text:

```bash
curl -s localhost:30000/generate -d '{"text": "Repeat the sentence '\''The weather is very nice today.'\'' five times, one per line:\n", "sampling_params": {"temperature": 0, "max_new_tokens": 96, "repetition_penalty": 2.0}}'
```

For DSPARK, use the cookbook command: `--model-path openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B --trust-remote-code --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-draft-model-path openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B-DSpark --speculative-dspark-block-size 7`, with the same two extra flags.

## Not covered

- No accuracy or throughput runs.
- Not run on Hopper/Blackwell or multi-GPU. Grammar-constrained requests are covered by a unit test only.
- `min_tokens` has no end-to-end check.
- As in EAGLE, one token per request is cumulated per verify step. With multi-token accepts, penalties don't see tokens accepted mid-block, and `min_tokens` counts verify steps, so EOS stays masked for about `min_tokens` times the accept length. Changing that would affect EAGLE too.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""DFLASH and DSPARK must not silently drop request penalties at verify
+(sgl-project/sglang#46752); like EAGLE, they cumulate one token per step."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import ScheduleBatch  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.sampling.penaltylib.frequency_penalty import (  # noqa: E402
+    BatchedFrequencyPenalizer,
+)
+from sglang.srt.sampling.penaltylib.orchestrator import (  # noqa: E402
+    BatchedPenalizerOrchestrator,
+)
+from sglang.srt.sampling.penaltylib.repetition_penalty import (  # noqa: E402
+    BatchedRepetitionPenalizer,
+)
+from sglang.srt.sampling.sampling_batch_info import SamplingBatchInfo  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.speculative.dflash_utils import (  # noqa: E402
+    apply_dflash_verify_logits_adjustments,
+)
+from sglang.srt.speculative.dflash_worker_v2 import DFlashWorkerV2  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.speculative.dspark_components.dspark_verify import (  # noqa: E402
+    verify_logits_adjustments_are_noop,
+)
+from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_utils import spec_prepare_for_decode  # noqa: E402
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+VOCAB_SIZE = 8
+DRAFT_TOKEN_NUM = 3
+REPETITION_PENALTIES = (2.0, 1.0)
+FREQUENCY_PENALTIES = (0.5, 1.5)
+LAST_OUTPUT_TOKENS = (5, 1)
+GRAMMAR_BANNED_TOKEN = 3
+
+
+def _make_req(repetition_penalty, frequency_penalty, last_output_token):
+    req = MagicMock()
+    req.sampling_params.repetition_penalty = repetition_penalty
+    req.sampling_params.frequency_penalty = frequency_penalty
+    req.output_ids = [last_output_token]
+    req.origin_input_ids = [0]
+    return req
+
+
+def _make_penalized_batch():
+    reqs = [
+        _make_req(*params)
+        for params in zip(REPETITION_PENALTIES, FREQUENCY_PENALTIES, LAST_OUTPUT_TOKENS)
+    ]
+    batch = ScheduleBatch(reqs=reqs)
+    batch.device = "cpu"
+    orchestrator = BatchedPenalizerOrchestrator(
+        VOCAB_SIZE,
+        batch,
+        {BatchedRepetitionPenalizer, BatchedFrequencyPenalizer},
+    )
+    bs = len(reqs)
+    batch.sampling_info = SamplingBatchInfo(
+        temperatures=torch.ones(bs, 1),
+        top_ps=torch.ones(bs),
+        top_ks=torch.ones(bs, dtype=torch.int32),
+        min_ps=torch.zeros(bs),
+        is_all_greedy=True,
+        is_any_greedy=True,
+        need_top_p_sampling=False,
+        need_top_k_sampling=False,
+        need_min_p_sampling=False,
+        vocab_size=VOCAB_SIZE,
+        penalizer_orchestrator=orchestrator,
+        device="cpu",
+    )
+    return batch
+
+
+def _verify_logits(bs):
+    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+    return torch.randn(bs * DRAFT_TOKEN_NUM, VOCAB_SIZE, generator=generator)
+
+
+class TestDFlashVerifyAppliesPenalties(CustomTestCase):
+    def _assert_matches_spec_penalty_semantics(self, grammar_mask=None):
+        batch = _make_penalized_batch()
+        orchestrator = batch.sampling_info.penalizer_orchestrator
+        orchestrator.cumulate_output_tokens(torch.tensor(LAST_OUTPUT_TOKENS))
+        logits = _verify_logits(len(batch.reqs))
+        expected = logits.clone()
+        orchestrator.apply(expected, repeat=DRAFT_TOKEN_NUM)
+        self.assertFalse(torch.equal(expected, logits))
+
+        sampling_info = batch.sampling_info.copy_for_forward()
+        if grammar_mask is not None:
+            sampling_info.grammar_mask = grammar_mask
+            grammar_mask.apply(expected)
+
+        apply_dflash_verify_logits_adjustments(
+            next_token_logits=logits,
+            sampling_info=sampling_info,
+            draft_token_num=DRAFT_TOKEN_NUM,
+        )
+
+        torch.testing.assert_close(logits, expected)
+
+    def test_scheduler_handoff_penalties_reach_every_verify_row(self):
+        """Every verify row gets its request's penalties from the
+        copy_for_forward() sampling info the scheduler hands the worker."""
+        self._assert_matches_spec_penalty_semantics()
+
+    def test_grammar_mask_keeps_repetition_penalty(self):
+        """A grammar-constrained batch keeps repetition_penalty at verify."""
+        self._assert_matches_spec_penalty_semantics(
+            grammar_mask=SimpleNamespace(
+                apply=lambda logits: logits[:, GRAMMAR_BANNED_TOKEN].fill_(
+                    float("-inf")
+                )
+            )
+        )
+
+
+class TestDFlashFastPathsSeePenalties(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_noop_check_sees_folded_penalties(self):
+        penalized = _make_penalized_batch().sampling_info.copy_for_forward()
+        self.assertFalse(verify_logits_adjustments_are_noop(penalized))
+
+        plain = _make_penalized_batch().sampling_info
+        plain.penalizer_orchestrator.is_required = False
+        self.assertTrue(verify_logits_adjustments_are_noop(plain.copy_for_forward()))
+
+    def test_greedy_argmax_skip_refused_with_folded_penalties(self):
+        """A penalized greedy batch must not take the argmax before penalties."""
+        penalized = _make_penalized_batch().sampling_info.copy_for_forward()
+        worker = SimpleNamespace(_selector_sample=None)
+        batch = SimpleNamespace(has_grammar=False, return_logprob=False)
+
+        self.assertFalse(
+            DFlashWorkerV2._can_skip_verify_logits(worker, batch, penalized)
+        )
+
+
+class TestDFlashDecodePrepCumulatesPenalties(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        override = get_context().override_server_args(
+            mamba_radix_cache_strategy="no_buffer"
+        )
+        override.install()
+        self.addCleanup(override.restore)
+
+    def _frequency_state(self, batch):
+        penalizers = batch.sampling_info.penalizer_orchestrator.penalizers
+        return penalizers[BatchedFrequencyPenalizer].cumulated_frequency_penalties
+
+    def _expected_frequency_state(self, steps):
+        expected = torch.zeros(len(LAST_OUTPUT_TOKENS), VOCAB_SIZE)
+        for row, (token, penalty) in enumerate(
+            zip(LAST_OUTPUT_TOKENS, FREQUENCY_PENALTIES)
+        ):
+            expected[row, token] = penalty * steps
+        return expected
+
+    def test_dflash_family_cumulates_once_per_decode_step(self):
+        batch = _make_penalized_batch()
+        batch.spec_algorithm = SimpleNamespace(
+            is_dflash_family=lambda: True, is_uno=lambda: False
+        )
